_description.summary: User interface and visuals: icons and markers on the map, draw text, rectangle and line, speck (floating pattern) control, shader vision, hotbar and key or mouse input reflections, telepathy, news and chat display, sounds and particles, Animated Scroll ink.
use_cases: Drawing icons, text or shapes on screen or map

manifestation:create_list_menu.d: Takes a list of intents, a menu title and manifests a list menu.

manifestation:create_grid_menu.d: Takes a list of intents, a menu title, and a number of columns to manifest a grid menu. Columns are limited to 1-10.

manifestation:create_radial_menu.d: Takes a list of intents and a menu title to manifest a radial button menu. Radial menus only accept button intents

manifestation:intent_button.d: Creates a button from a list of patterns and a label. When clicked, the button casts the patterns. The patterns are cast in their own environment so they can't use special patterns specific to spell circles or charms. They inherit the stack of environment they are cast from.

manifestation:intent_input.d: Creates an input field from a label. Entered text is pushed to the stack of an executed action, like from a button.

manifestation:intent_numeric_input.d: Creates a numeric input from a default value and label. The entered number is pushed to the stack of an executed action.

manifestation:intent_slider.d: Creates a slider from min, max, current values, and a label. The chosen value is pushed to the stack of an executed action.

manifestation:intent_checkbox.d: Creates a checkbox from a default checked state and label. The resulting boolean is pushed to the stack of an executed action.

manifestation:intent_select_list.d: Creates a selectable list from options, a max visible row count, and a label. Optionally accepts a boolean to enable multi-select. The selected option or options are pushed to the stack of an executed action.

manifestation:intent_section.d: Creates a non-interactive section from a label, acting as a sub heading.

manifestation:intent_dropdown.d: Creates a dropdown from a list of options and a label. The selected option is pushed to the stack of an executed action.

manifestation:link_intent_relay.d: Takes a destination vector for where the relay will go, then a face vector to choose which side to manifest it on, and then a target vector for the thing to link the relay to.

manifestation:open_corridor_portal.d: Takes a vector, a Prescence intent, media allocation and an optional string label and pigment. Opens a portal bridging two locations together.**Cost: 2 dust per second. 35 Charged Crystal on frame.**

manifestation:presence_intent.d: Takes a location and a directional vector and creates an intent. Used with manifest threshold.**Cost: 35 amethyst.**

manifestation:destroy_manifestation.d: Takes an origin vector and a radius, destroys manifestations (portals and relays) in that area. Based on permissions.

manifestation:manifest_splinter.d: Creates a splinter at a position, with a delay and a list of patterns to cast. The splinter casts the payload as if it were the caster, then collapses. The splinter's location is only visible to its creator.

manifestation:destroy_splinters.d: Dismisses all splinters you have active.

manifestation:hex_trail.d: Hex Trail creates a particle trail as it moves. By using the same ID across casts you can create a continuous trail that moves smoothy between positions.
manifestation:hex_trail.i: vec, vec, vec, num, num, num?

manifestation:equation_hex_cloud.d: Creates large particle effects from an Equation Particle iota to avoid large vector lists. The Iota can be created using an Equation Synthesizer block. Uses an ID to keep positional state like Hex Trail.

manifestation:spell_circle.d: Projects a solid spell circle into the world displaying a pattern for a duration before disintegrating.**Cost: 1/500 dust.**

manifestation:set_charm_cast_sound.d:
Changes the sound a charmed item makes when casting.
Top of stack is string, text, or null.**Cost: 10 dust.**

manifestation:memory_reflection.d: Returns the held or embedded Memory Crystal's unique memory identifier. Favours the off-hand first.

manifestation:replay_memory.d: Returns the stored memory pattern (or null if none) from a held or embedded Memory Crystal. Takes a Memory Iota from Memory Reflection. Favours the off-hand first.

manifestation:store_memory.d: Stores the top of the stack in a held or embedded Memory Crystal's memory. Takes a Memory Iota from Memory Reflection. Favours the off-hand first.

manifestation:mind_vault_counts.d: Takes a vector of a mind vault location and returns [ready, total], where ready is the number of stored minds not on cooldown and total is the number of stored minds in the vault.

manifestation:exit_if_interacting.d: Exits a hex if caster uses something interactable. Useful for charmed items that use righ-click.

manifestation:open_casting_screen.d: Opens the spell grid and must be cast by a person.

hexmapping:create_marker/circle.d: Creates a new Circle Marker with the provided identifier, label, position, and radius

hexmapping:create_marker/rectangle.d: Creates a new Rectangle Marker with the provided identifier, label, top corner, and bottom corner

hexmapping:create_marker/polygon.d: Creates a new Polygon Marker with the provided identifier, label, and list of positions OR a Hexical Mesh Entity

hexmapping:create_marker/polyline.d: Creates a new Polyline Marker with the provided identifier, label, and list of positions OR a Hexical Mesh Entity

hexmapping:create_marker/icon.d: Creates a new Icon Marker with the provided identifier, label, icon, and position

hexmapping:has_marker.d: Checks if a marker exists on the map under the provided identifier

hexmapping:set_fill_color.d: Sets the Fill Color of a marker, if applicable (Circle, Rectangle, and Polygon)

hexmapping:set_line_color.d: Sets the Line Color of a marker, if applicable (Circle, Rectangle, Polyline, and Polygon)

hexmapping:set_line_weight.d: Sets the Line Weight of a marker, if applicable (Circle, Rectangle, Polyline, and Polygon)

hexmapping:get_maps/bluemap.d: Pushes a list of Maps for your current dimension from Bluemap to the stack

hexmapping:get_maps/dynmap.d: Pushes a list of Maps for your current dimension from Dynmap to the stack

hexmapping:get_maps/pl3xmap.d: Pushes a list of Maps for your current dimension from Pl3xmap to the stack

hexmapping:get_maps/squaremap.d: Pushes a list of Maps for your current dimension from Squaremap to the stack

hexical:glow_scroll.d: Causes the ink of an Animated Scroll to brightly glow, regardless of lighting conditions.

hexical:conjure_speck.d: Conjures a speck with the iota, position, and rotation. Costs a negligible amount of media. Pushes the speck iota to the stack.

hexical:move_specklike.d: Moves a speck entity to the position.

hexical:rotate_specklike.d: Rotates a speck entity to face the vector.

hexical:roll_specklike.d: Accepts a number between 0 and 1, representing a fraction of a full rotation, and rotates the speck's image by that amount.

hexical:size_specklike.d: Scales the speck, can range from 0 to 10. Represents size in blocks and is zero by default.

hexical:thickness_specklike.d: Changes the stroke thickness of a pattern speck, can range from 0 to 10. Represents twentieths of a block, and is zero by default.

hexical:lifetime_specklike.d: Commands the speck to disappear after that many twentieths of a second.

hexpose:get_chat.d: Applies News Reflection to the last up to 32 messages in chat, wraps each in a list, and pushes a list of those lists.

scryglass:get_window_size.d: Returns the full width and height of my vision as a vector.

scryglass:get_icons.d: Pushes a list of the indices of all the Icons I have. This appears as a list of numbers.

scryglass:draw_text.d: Takes an index, a position, a number, and any iota. Conjures an Icon displaying that iota.

scryglass:draw_rect.d: Takes an index, a position, a size, and a color. Conjures an Icon displaying that rectangle.

scryglass:draw_line.d: Takes an index, a position, a size, and a color. Conjures an Icon that joins between the two with a thin line.

scryglass:rotate_icon.d: Takes an index and an amount of rotation counterclockwise in terms of a full circle. Rotates the icon.

scryglass:scale_icon.d: Takes an index and a scaling factor. Scales the icon.
